biography: Carlos Thomas, a name whispered with a mix of excitement and apprehension in the junior racing circuits, hails from the remote, snow-dusted fjords of Norway. Born into a family with no prior motorsport connection, Carlos's passion ignited during a local ice racing event at age 10. He convinced his father, a fisherman, to let him try it. His raw talent was immediately apparent – a natural feel for car control on treacherous surfaces. Leaving home at 15 with a handful of borrowed Euros and a burning ambition, Carlos's early career was marked by scrappy independent entries, sleeping in the back of vans, and relying on the kindness of strangers. A defining moment came at the Junior Nordic Championship where, despite starting last due to a mechanical failure in qualifying, he carved his way through the field to finish second, showcasing his aggressive overtaking and fearless attitude. Now, at 17, Carlos is an independent driver making waves with a bare-bones operation, turning heads with his raw speed and uncompromising style. He is on the cusp of breaking into a major junior formula.
drivingStyle: Carlos's driving style is characterized by relentless aggression and a willingness to push the limits of his car and the track. He attacks corners with a ferocity that often surprises his rivals, favoring late braking and daring overtaking maneuvers. While his tire management is still a work in progress, his natural car control allows him to recover from slides and maintain momentum even in challenging conditions. Under pressure, Carlos thrives, often finding an extra gear when the stakes are highest, suggesting a coolness and focus beneath his aggressive exterior.

rivalries.reason: A clash of egos and driving styles. Anton, from a wealthy racing family, represents the establishment that Carlos is trying to disrupt.
A fierce on-track rivalry stemming from a controversial incident where Carlos aggressively overtook Isabelle, forcing her off the track. There's respect, but also animosity.
Kenji and Carlos have been closely matched competitors since karting, pushing each other to the limit in every race. Their battles are always hard-fought and frequently end in dramatic finishes.

quirks: Always wears a small, hand-carved wooden troll given to him by his grandmother inside his race suit.
Listens to traditional Norwegian folk music on repeat for one hour before every race.
Refuses to wash his racing gloves during a race weekend, believing the dirt and grime add to his grip.
famousQuote: "Fear is a luxury I can't afford on the track. If you're not willing to risk it all, you're not here to win."
careerHighlight: Finishing second at the Junior Nordic Championship after starting last due to mechanical failure. This displayed his remarkable recovery skills and overtaking prowess.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of a regional race due to overconfidence, costing him a potential championship victory and valuable sponsorship opportunities.
